China urges Israel to halt West Bank settlements amid farmer land access dispute

China has called on Israel to cease the "forced establishment" of West Bank settlements. This statement comes as Palestinian farmers have petitioned the High Court regarding three years of blocked access to their land. Separately, settlers reportedly set fire to a mosque in the West Bank while Israeli forces raided villages.
